imperative verb directing the bringing into control
compound designating the concluding coded elements of the mantra

items.question: What concluding petition and coded designation complete the Gaṇapati mantra formula?
premises: The imperative ānaya directs bringing the speaker under control.
The syllable svāhā functions as the concluding oblation term of the mantra.
The compound viṃśatyantagajāntakaḥ specifies the final coded designation in the formula.
items.inference: The mantra concludes by petitioning subjugation to the speaker and sealing the formula with svāhā and a coded designation.
uncertainties: The precise technical decoding of viṃśatyantagajāntakaḥ within this mantra system is not fully explicit from the verse alone.
items.plain_english: Bring me under control, svāhā — ending in viṃśati and Gajāntaka.
